tools.name: list_challenge_plans
tools.title: List challenge plans
tools.description: List the available Prop Gym funded-account challenge plans with pricing, account sizes, profit targets, and drawdown limits. Public, no login required.

challenge_type.description: Optional filter by challenge type, e.g. one_step, two_step, or instant.

tools.name: list_my_trading_accounts
tools.title: List my trading accounts
tools.description: List the signed-in user's funded/challenge trading accounts with balance, phase, status, profit progress, and drawdown. Requires login.

tools.name: get_my_wallet
tools.title: Get my wallet
tools.description: Get the signed-in user's Prop Gym wallet: current balance, total earnings, and total withdrawn (USD). Requires login.

tools.name: list_my_purchases
tools.title: List my challenge purchases
tools.description: List the signed-in user's challenge purchase orders with status, linked plan, and creation date. Requires login.
